notes.title: Huge Prologue Update & Overhaul Ahead of Full Game Release
notes.notes:
It's been a while since we've updated Acolyte: Prologue, but today - alongside the full beta release of the game for Transcendent Edition owners - we've also rolled out all the fixes, improvements and additions to the final game, to the Prologue. 

This includes:


 More natural language dialogue responses 
 Smoother conversation flow (although still work to be done here ahead of release) 
 New Acolyte features (jokes/facts/games)
 New Customisation options 
 ....and a host of other fixes and improvements. 


In addition to this, we've also released a brand new trailer for the game - showcasing the game's natural language input and ARG puzzles. 

[previewyoutube=n36pXZtA35M;full][/previewyoutube]

IMPORTAT NOTE: Acolyte is still in the final phase of development where lots of bugs are purged, polish is added and generally the game comes together. You may still experience some issues. If you would like to wait for the final, polished version: please continue to wait a short while longer.  

Huge thanks. 

Jamin & the Superstring team.

notes.title: Acolyte Prologue v1.1 Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39544656/9fdb10d08c28b00e57e92f8646d35ffff8af9aef.png

Back in January we released an early version of our new narrative game, Acolyte. Before development of the full  game continues, we were keen to roll out a little update to the Prologue which addresses some frequent requests and issues, and improves the overall user experience. 

In the v1.1 Update - available now! - players can benefit from:  


 New resolution options (and persistence between sessions)
 New dialogue options 
 Expanded vocabulary 
 Light Mode - dark text on light backgrounds, for those that find reading easier
 Improved UX and key information delivery 
 Various fixes and improvements 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39544656/52e2bbbe6278876ef764e83ffb89593b98d9fdfd.png

To those that have yet to play the game, there's no better time. But that's not to say there's not still work to do! Please continue to reach out with your thoughts and feedback, and your comments will be channelled into the ongoing development of the full game. 

Until next time, 

Jamin

notes.title: Update #1 | An Acolyte Launch Day FAQ
notes.notes:
Announce day! Ahh! Thank you to everybody that has checked out the game so far; it's been amazing to see people chatting with their Acolytes for the first time and getting absorbed in the world of the game.

If you've not checked out the game's in-fiction Announce trailer yet, have a gander:  

[previewyoutube=kJHIIdkFy0U;full][/previewyoutube]

Superstring has been hard at work on Acolyte since the launch of our first game, Headspun, and today we've finally revealed it to the world. Not only that, we've released a playable demo, and people are literally playing it right now. Scary stuff. 

Acolyte is still in development, with the Prologue acting as a vital tool for improving the dialogue and story flow, and building towards the full release. 

In the short time the game has been available, we've had a bunch of questions come through, so I thought I'd assemble an FAQ here for the benefit of the masses. 

If you have a question that isn't covered below, please do reach out. 

Jamin

--

IS ACOLYTE STILL IN DEVELOPMENT?
It is! Acolyte: Prologue is the first third or so of the game, with development ongoing to bring the finished game, with its full and final feature-set, to release. The demo is feature/story complete, but not representative of final quality. The whole reason behind the Prologue is to watch people play, observe how they interact with their Acolyte, and iterate and improve on the dialogue and story flow. 

ACOLYTE HAS ‘ARG ELEMENTS’? WHAT DOES THAT MEAN!?
It means that the game also takes place outside of the game client itself. To unravel Acolyte’s mystery and solve some of its puzzles, you’ll need to expand your thinking, and be prepared to think outside the box….

I'M STUCK ON PUZZLE [x] - WHAT DO I DO? 
Firstly, please don't post story/puzzle spoilers here on itch or otherwise - half the fun is working out what to do here, but they can involve some 'out of the box thinking'. If you're really stuck and think there might be a proper, real life bug - please get in touch [support[at]superstring[dot]studio

I'VE FOUND A *REAL* BUG (AS OPPOSE TO A FICTIONAL ONE)!
Ack! I'm sorry! Acolyte will be receiving updates as development continues. Please let us know your issue, and we'll fix up asap for you. Apologies for any trouble here. 

DO I NEED AN INTERNET CONNECTION TO PLAY?
Not as such, no. You can play Acolyte without any connection at all, but in order to experience the full story and be able to solve certain puzzles, you will need access to various web pages.

WHY DOES ACOLYTE HAVE A PORTRAIT RESOLUTION?
Acolyte is designed to emulate a mobile device. The full release will also be coming to mobile, but the PC version also retains this resolution to best suit it’s design. The game is also designed to be played in a way that allows you access to other windows and tabs…

DO I GET A STEAM KEY WITH THE TRANSCENDENT EDITION?
Yes! Anybody that purchases the Transcendent Edition buys into the full game at an early bird price, and also secures a Steam key and future milestone builds of the game (should they wish to play - some may prefer to wait until it's final). 

I’M A WRITERY/VIDEO MEDIA-TYPE PERSON, DOES ACOLYTE HAVE A PRESS KIT?
It does! You can download the Acolyte press kit from here.

--
